description: I’m Zaryab, an A-Level student interested in physics, space, engineering, and technology. Orbit Foundry is our project for the Space Mission Design Game challenge, combining my interests in physics, mathematics, and coding.
summary: ORBIT FOUNDRY is an early-stage space mission simulation game prototype developed using the Godot game engine. The project aims to introduce players to the world of spacecraft engineering and space mission planning through an interactive gaming experience. The current prototype includes a custom-designed main menu featuring the game's identity and navigation interface. The overall vision is to create an educational simulation where players can explore spacecraft design, mission planning, resource management, and the challenges of space exploration. ORBIT FOUNDRY represents the initial stage of this vision, with the main menu serving as the foundation for future development.
details:
ORBIT FOUNDRY is an early-stage space mission simulation game concept developed using Godot Engine and GDScript.

The current work focuses on establishing the game's identity and user interface. A custom main menu has been developed, featuring the ORBIT FOUNDRY title, a space-themed visual environment, and navigation options including Start New Game, Load Game, Options, and Quit Game.

The project is designed around the idea of making space mission engineering more accessible through gaming. Its future vision includes spacecraft configuration, mission planning, resource management, launch preparation, and mission operations.

The current submission showcases the initial development work rather than a completed game. It demonstrates the project's visual direction, interface design, technical foundation, and potential for future development.

Godot Engine and GDScript were used for development, with ChatGPT providing AI-assisted programming guidance and brainstorming.
